{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Fir Megsan''' was the child of a [[Fir Megsan's father|soldier]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during<ref name="Lord Praven">{{TORcite|type=message|Lord Praven|Fir Megsan}}</ref> the [[Great Galactic War]]<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Megsan's father was present on<ref name="Lord Praven" /> the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of<ref name="TORE" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the Empire's [[Sacking of Coruscant]]<ref name="Lord Praven" /> in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="TORE" /> and the man was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Praven]]. In response, Megsan set a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]], but every [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who attempted to kill Praven were instead killed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], whom Megsan saw as a "scum" and "pompous butcher."<ref name="Lord Praven" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Heard through the grapevine that you fought and killed Lord Pravan on Tatooine. Guess that makes me your new biggest fan, even though we've never met.|Fir Megsan, in their message to the player|<ref name="Lord Praven" />}}
Fir Megsan is mentioned in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the author of a message to players of the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] character<ref name="Lord Praven" /> who have chosen at least one [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] option after their [[Duel on the Esus Mesa|confrontation]] with [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Praven on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Desert Duel">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Desert Duel|Tatooine}}</ref> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Act I">{{TOR dates|1}}</ref> instead of convincing him to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] points.<ref name="Desert Duel" /> In the message, Megsan expresses gratitude to the player for avenging their father, explaining that he had died during the Sacking of Coruscant, and that everyone who pursued the bounty that was placed on Lord Praven "caught a serious case of corpse." The message is additionally attached with some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as reward.<ref name="Lord Praven" /> However, this article assumes the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] to be a light side character, and so Megsan's bounty is assumed to never have been fulfilled.
